parameters.name: AccessMode
parameters.description:
The switchover policy for the address pool collection:

- AUTO: Automatic switchover

- DEFAULT: Primary address pool collection

- FAILOVER: Failover address pool collection

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the address pool in the primary address pool collection.

sub_parameters.name: LbaWeight
sub_parameters.description: The weight of the address pool in the primary address pool collection.

parameters.name: DefaultAddrPoolType
parameters.description:
The type of the primary address pool:

- IPV4

- IPV6

- DOMAIN

parameters.name: DefaultLatencyOptimization
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable latency-based scheduling for the primary address pool collection:

- OPEN: Enabled

- CLOSE: Disabled

parameters.name: DefaultLbaStrategy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy for the primary address pool collection:

- ALL\_RR: Returns all addresses.

- RATIO: Returns addresses by weight.

parameters.name: DefaultMaxReturnAddrNum
parameters.description: The maximum number of addresses returned from the primary address pool collection.

parameters.name: DefaultMinAvailableAddrNum
parameters.description: The minimum number of available addresses in the primary address pool collection.

parameters.name: FailoverAddrPool
parameters.description: The failover address pool collection. If no failover address pool collection is configured, enter "EMPTY".

sub_parameters.name: Id
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the address pool in the failover address pool collection.

sub_parameters.name: LbaWeight
sub_parameters.description: The weight of the address pool in the failover address pool collection.

parameters.name: FailoverAddrPoolType
parameters.description:
The type of the failover address pool:

- IPV4

- IPV6

- DOMAIN

parameters.name: FailoverLatencyOptimization
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable latency-based scheduling for the failover address pool collection:

- OPEN: Enabled

- CLOSE: Disabled

parameters.name: FailoverLbaStrategy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy for the failover address pool collection:

- ALL\_RR: Returns all addresses.

- RATIO: Returns addresses by weight.

parameters.name: FailoverMaxReturnAddrNum
parameters.description: The maximum number of addresses returned from the failover address pool collection.

parameters.name: FailoverMinAvailableAddrNum
parameters.description: The minimum number of available addresses in the failover address pool collection.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: Lines
parameters.description: The line codes of the access regions. For example, `["default", "drpeng"]` specifies the global line and the Dr. Peng line.

parameters.name: StrategyId
parameters.description: The ID of the policy. To obtain the policy ID, call [DescribeDnsGtmAccessStrategies](~~2357191~~).
